manaNeeded: {7}{W}{W}{B}{B} minus {W/B} for each nontoken Knight you control
notablePrerequisites: There are at least 11 Knights between nontoken creatures you control and cards in your graveyard.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing each Knight you control, adding {W/B} for each Knight.
When you sacrifice Cavalier of Dawn, its second ability triggers, returning Knights' Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Knights' Charge by paying {1}{W}{B}.
Activate Knights' Charge by paying {6}{W}{B} and sacrificing it, returning all Knights from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
